# The Atlantic
> A magazine and digital publication covering politics, ideas, culture, technology, science, health, global affairs, and more through articles, podcasts, videos, newsletters, and special projects.

The Atlantic publishes reported features, analysis, criticism, essays, visual journalism, and magazine stories across major public-interest topics. Its site organizes coverage into topical sections, recurring projects, newsletters, podcasts, and print-edition features.

## Core Navigation
- [Home](https://www.theatlantic.com/): The Atlantic homepage with featured reporting, essays, and magazine stories.
- [Latest](https://www.theatlantic.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published Atlantic stories.
- [Most Popular](https://www.theatlantic.com/most-popular/): The site’s most-read articles and essays.
- [Newsletters](https://www.theatlantic.com/newsletters/): Newsletter hub with editorial email products and subscription options.
- [Projects](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/): Landing page for editorial projects and special series.

## Politics & Ideas
- [Politics](https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/): Coverage of U.S. politics, elections, government, and public policy.
- [Ideas](https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas/): Essays, arguments, and opinion writing on politics and society.
- [International](https://www.theatlantic.com/international/): Global affairs, geopolitics, and international reporting and analysis.
- [Economy](https://www.theatlantic.com/economy/): Reporting and commentary on markets, labor, inequality, and economic policy.
- [Education](https://www.theatlantic.com/education/): Coverage of schools, universities, learning, and education policy.

## Technology, Science & Health
- [Technology](https://www.theatlantic.com/technology/): Reporting on the tech industry, platforms, AI, and digital life.
- [Science](https://www.theatlantic.com/science/): Science reporting on research, discovery, environment, and public understanding.
- [Health](https://www.theatlantic.com/health/): Coverage of medicine, public health, mental health, and wellness.
- [AI Watchdog](https://www.theatlantic.com/category/ai-watchdog/): Atlantic coverage focused on artificial intelligence and its consequences.
- [Planet](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/planet/): Project-based climate and environmental journalism.

## Culture & Criticism
- [Culture](https://www.theatlantic.com/culture/): Criticism and reporting on film, television, music, and cultural trends.
- [Books](https://www.theatlantic.com/books/): Book reviews, literary criticism, and author-focused essays.
- [Fiction](https://www.theatlantic.com/category/fiction/): Short fiction published by The Atlantic.
- [Photo](https://www.theatlantic.com/photo/): Photography, photo essays, and visual storytelling.
- [Projects](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/): Special editorial packages spanning culture, politics, and society.

## Special Projects
- [Projects](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/): Directory of The Atlantic’s editorial projects and thematic series.
- [Planet](https://www.theatlantic.com/projects/planet/): Climate-focused project collecting environmental reporting and essays.
- [AI Watchdog](https://www.theatlantic.com/category/ai-watchdog/): Ongoing category tracking AI developments, risks, and governance.
- [Photo](https://www.theatlantic.com/photo/): Visual project area for image-driven reporting and galleries.

## Newsletters & Recurring Formats
- [Newsletters](https://www.theatlantic.com/newsletters/): Browse and subscribe to The Atlantic’s editorial newsletters.
- [Latest](https://www.theatlantic.com/latest/): Useful entry point for following ongoing coverage across desks.
- [Most Popular](https://www.theatlantic.com/most-popular/): Reader-interest view of current standout stories.
- [The Atlantic Home](https://www.theatlantic.com/): Main hub for articles, podcasts, videos, and magazine features.

## Print Edition & Magazine
- [The Atlantic Home](https://www.theatlantic.com/): Homepage regularly features stories from the flagship magazine.
- [Latest](https://www.theatlantic.com/latest/): Includes newly published magazine and web stories.
- [Culture](https://www.theatlantic.com/culture/): Frequent home for criticism and essays appearing in magazine context.
- [Ideas](https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas/): Essays and argument-driven pieces often associated with magazine-style writing.

## Topic Sections
- [Politics](https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/): Political reporting, analysis, and commentary.
- [Technology](https://www.theatlantic.com/technology/): Technology reporting and analysis.
- [Science](https://www.theatlantic.com/science/): Science and environment coverage.
- [Economy](https://www.theatlantic.com/economy/): Economics, work, and policy coverage.
- [Culture](https://www.theatlantic.com/culture/): Arts and culture criticism.
- [Health](https://www.theatlantic.com/health/): Health and medicine reporting.
- [Education](https://www.theatlantic.com/education/): Education reporting and commentary.
- [International](https://www.theatlantic.com/international/): Global affairs and international analysis.
